To make it easier to find a time, here are all the 30-minute slots where Priya and Marcus are both free next week:

workspace.author: Brad
workspace.text:
Hi Alison, I've double-checked Elena's and David's calendars, and my analysis is the same: none of the times you provided are currently free for them. It seems we have a complete lack of overlapping availability.

I agree we're at an impasse if we only look at free slots. How about we see if one of the partners can move a conflicting appointment? Since this meeting is for all four of them, it's likely a priority.

Looking at your list, Thursday at 10:00 AM could be a possibility. On my side, only Elena Soto is busy at that time with a "Hiring panel". David Okafor is free. Perhaps a hiring panel is something she can reschedule.

Before I approach her, can you confirm that this time is still solid for Priya and Marcus and that there are no other options on your end? If so, I can move forward with the request.
